paragraphs: LION Group sells fire training equipment and facilities, and its own pages describe it as the largest provider of that equipment for first responders. The training catalogue runs from live fire props such as the Vehicle Fire Training Prop and the Dumpster Fire Training Prop to digital systems and smoke generators. Protective equipment covers turnout gear, helmets, hoods, gloves, boots and coveralls, with hoods sold under the RedZone name.

Uniforms are listed as Fire Uniforms, Law Enforcement Uniforms and EMS Uniforms. Gear care is sold as TotalCare, covering cleaning, inspection and repair, and the pages also list a PPE rental program. A supply chain arm is named as LVI Military Logistics.

On who buys, the site says LION is big enough to deliver on the largest fire department contracts. The same sentence names every emergency responder and firefighter that uses the equipment. Buyers are pointed to a sales rep by state, and the page also lists a dealer finder and an online shop.

quote.text: LION is the largest provider of fire training equipment and facilities for first responders, having built the last three largest first responder training facilities in the world.
